description: Drizzle schema and migrations for Margin Minder cost catalog and quote scenario entities.
notes: Required by .aidd/spec.md; no cost_catalog_items, quote_scenarios, scenario_line_items, scenario_labor_entries, or scenario_fixed_costs schema files were found during onboarding.
spec:
1. Add SQLite and PostgreSQL Drizzle schema files for cost_catalog_items.
2. Add SQLite and PostgreSQL Drizzle schema files for quote_scenarios.
3. Add SQLite and PostgreSQL Drizzle schema files for scenario_line_items.
4. Add SQLite and PostgreSQL Drizzle schema files for scenario_labor_entries.
5. Add SQLite and PostgreSQL Drizzle schema files for scenario_fixed_costs.
6. Use snake_case database names and camelCase TypeScript fields.
7. Add explicit foreign keys from scenario child tables to quote_scenarios.
8. Add indexes for scenario_id, active catalog items, status, and updated_at where appropriate.
9. Export every schema from backend/src/db/schema/index.ts and backend/src/db/schema-pg/index.ts.
10. Generate and apply aligned migrations without placing database files outside data/.
title: Margin Data Schema
